Commentary.Commentary: That's it from this game then, The season is nothing but over for Sri Lanka. The highlight of the match though will be the Mathews wicket which has already made the news everywhere. Whether it was in the spirit of cricket or not, it is up to you to decide. However, the verbal disagreements by the Lankans in both innings and the rivalry continuing with the Bangla players did shift Sri Lanka's focus off the game. Another game follows on Tuesday as Australia will be taking on Afghanistan. Join us on 2 pm IST (8.30 am GMT) and earlier for the build-up. Cheers!

Shakib Al Hasan says he knew dew would click in later on and they had to bat well. Luckily they got big partnerships and chased it down. Tells Towhid Hridoy and Najmul Hossain Shanto have the potential and they are backing them. Mentions one of their fielders came and told him to appeal about the time. Says it is in the laws but he felt like he was at war, right or wrong there will be debates but he had to take the decision. Tells the incident helped to show them more fight.

Kusal Mendis says they were 30-40 runs short. Adds there are few young players coming through and have shown a lot of promise. Reckons there were a couple of injuries to key players which made a lot of difference. On the wicket of Angelo Mathews, he says it was disappointing as he feels there were still a couple of seconds left but is disappointed that common sense was not shown by the umpires.

Shakib Al Hasan is the Player of the Match for his all-round performance. He says there wasn't much for the seamers but initially they bowled well and the spinners did well in the middle phase. They weren't upto their expectation but the belief was always there. Reckons he just hit through the line and luckily it came off for him. Tells they could have been more consistent in the tournament.
...Presentation next...

To be honest, 280 was never going to be enough and credit to the Bangladesh bowlers to keep them to that total. Also, A lot of credit to the middle order of Bangladesh to step up when needed. A complete performance from them.

For Sri Lanka, Dilshan Madhushanka was outstanding, he got them two early wickets but failed to get any support from the other end. Mathews got two wickets but it was too late by them. They needed to strike early but except for Dilshan Madhushanka, nobody hit the right lines and lengths. They got some hope late in the game but were always short of runs.

That's a thumping win for Bangladesh. Quite a dominating performance in the end. They've put on a clinical show here in Delhi. They weren't chasing a big total but it was surely a competitive one. However, they batted really well against the new ball. That has been their problem in the previous games but this time they were a lot watchful and also managed to score at a decent rate. Yes, they did lose Das and Tanzid in the first 10 overs but Shakib Al Hasan and Najmul Hossain Shanto were brilliant. They weathered the storm earlier on and then feasted on the conditions. Both scored fifties and added 100 between the two. Both fell in quick succession but they had done their job. The lower middle order of Bangladesh ensured they get over the line.
FOUR!  IT IS OVER! Shorter and on leg, Sakib helps it down to fine leg for a boundary. BANGLADESH WIN BY 3 WICKETS. Maheesh Theekshana lies on the ground with his head down gutted with the loss.

Commentary.Commentary: Good length and on off, defended. End of a successful over but he could have easily had two wickets in this over.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.6: Dilshan Madushanka to Litton Das, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Das does not want to hold back! This is fuller, he takes a step down the track, it is on the pads and swings away further. He looks to whip it but misses. Wided.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.6: Dilshan Madushanka to Litton Das, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: Das is in discomfort. He has an issue with his leg. The physio is out. He is limping for now. He is fine to go but we might not see some quick singles for a while from him.

DROPPED AND FOUR! How costly will that prove? Liton Das gets a life. Is that the kind of luck he needs to get going? That should have been taken. Sri Lanka need to take these half chances. A short one on the body, Litton Das looks to pull, it goes towards fine leg. Kusal Perera runs in, dives forward, gets two hands to it but can't hang on. Boundary in the end.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.5: Dilshan Madushanka to Litton Das, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length and around off, Litton Das guides it to point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.4: Dilshan Madushanka to Litton Das, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Najmul Hossain Shanto is off the mark! Around off and on a length, Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to defend but it goes off the outer half down to third man for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.3: Dilshan Madushanka to Najmul Hossain Shanto, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: BEATEN! Dilshan Madushanka has his tail up here. A cracking delivery to welcome the new batter. Good length and around off, this shapes away. Najmul Hossain Shanto is beaten as he tries to defend.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.2: Dilshan Madushanka to Najmul Hossain Shanto, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: OUT! TAKEN! Dilshan Madushanka hits back! He was taken for runs in his first over but now gets the wicket of Tanzid Hasan! He is delighted but that is a poor shot from Tanzid Hasan! This is full and wide outside off. Gets it to shape away just a little bit. Tanzid Hasan reaches out for it. It goes off the toe-end up in the air and the man at cover point takes it. Pathum Nissanka is the fielder. Najmul Hossain Shanto walks out to bat now.
Commentary.Howout: c Pathum Nissanka b Dilshan Madushanka
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.1: Dilshan Madushanka to Tanzid Hasan, OUT! c Pathum Nissanka b Dilshan Madushanka.

Commentary.Commentary: Another single to end and 7 from this over! Shorter and on off, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.6: Maheesh Theekshana to Tanzid Hasan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Nice and full, gets it to shape back in, this is worked down to long on for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Maheesh Theekshana to Litton Das, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter this time and on middle, Litton Das hangs back and works it to mid-wicket.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Maheesh Theekshana to Litton Das, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller and on middle, Litton Das works it to mid-wicket.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.3: Maheesh Theekshana to Litton Das, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Better! Starts this from outside off, defended.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Maheesh Theekshana to Litton Das, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Slips this one down the leg side. Wided. Maheesh Theekshana is getting it to swing a touch but it is the wrong line.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Maheesh Theekshana to Litton Das, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Maheesh Theekshana who is bowling from the other end, starts poorly. This is on the pads, Maheesh Theekshana works it past short fine leg. No in the deep and it races away. Raining bonudaries to begin with.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Maheesh Theekshana to Litton Das, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Brave! This is just the 6th ball of the chase and having got a boundary on the last ball, Tanzid Hasan wants another one. He steps out, makes this into a half volley and lofts it over the mid on fielder. Perfect start for Bangladesh.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.6: Dilshan Madushanka to Tanzid Hasan, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Up and over! First boundary of the chase and it is off the bat of Tanzid Hasan! Just uses the pace of the bowler. This is fuller and outside off, he just puts bat on ball, it goes over point and races away to the fence.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.5: Dilshan Madushanka to Tanzid Hasan, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Das is now underway! On the pads, Dilshan Madushanka works it through square leg for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Dilshan Madushanka to Litton Das, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: This time goes fuller but not a lot of movement, it is on off, Litton Das strokes it to mid off.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Dilshan Madushanka to Litton Das, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length and around off, Das guides it to point. No swing so far for Dilshan Madushanka but he has been a little too short.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Dilshan Madushanka to Litton Das, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Bangladesh are underway! Slightly shorter to begin with! It is on the pads, Tanzid Hasan looks to flick but misses, it hits the pad and rolls towards fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Dilshan Madushanka to Tanzid Hasan, Leg bye.
